title: Greetings
description: Open and close a conversation without sounding like a textbook.

questions.sentence: Namaskar, apana kemiti achanti?
options: Mu bhala achi, dhanyabad.
Mu ghara re achi ebe.
Mote tike pani darkar.
questions.translatedSentence: I am fine, thank you.

questions.sentence: Tume kemiti achha?
options: Mu bhala achi, aau tume?
Mu ebe ghara jauchi.
Mu tumaku jane nahin.
questions.translatedSentence: I am fine, and you?

questions.sentence: Mu bhala achi.
options: I am fine.
I am not well.
I am going now.

questions.sentence: Sabu thik achi to?
options: Han, sabu thik achi.
Nahin, mu jane nahin.
Mu tike bahara jauchi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, everything is fine.

questions.sentence: Apana kemiti achanti?
options: How are you?
Where are you going?
What is your name?

questions.sentence: Namaskar! Bhala achha to?
options: Han, mu bhala achi.
Nahin, mu tanka naam jane nahin.
Mu ebe kama karuchi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am fine.

questions.sentence: Ame sabu bhala achu.
options: We are all fine.
They are all fine.
You are all fine.

questions.sentence: Tumara ghara loka kemiti achanti?
options: Semane sabu bhala achanti.
Mu tanka ghara kouthi jane nahin.
Ame Cuttack re rahu.
questions.translatedSentence: They are all doing well.

questions.sentence: Mu tike bhala nahin achi.
options: I am not feeling very well.
I am feeling much better now.
I am not going there today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am not feeling very well.

questions.sentence: Subha sakala! Bhala nidra hela ki?
options: Han, bhala nidra hela, dhanyabad.
Nahin, mu ebe kichhi khaiba nahin.
Mu sakale bajaraku jaithili.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I slept well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Subha sakala, apana bhala achanti to?
options: Good morning, are you well?
Good night, did you sleep well?
Good evening, welcome to our home.

questions.sentence: Subha sandhya! Aajira dina kemiti gala?
options: Aaji dina bhala gala, dhanyabad.
Mu ratire tike bahara jibi.
Mu apananka naam jane nahin.
questions.translatedSentence: The day went well today, thank you.

questions.sentence: Subha ratri, bhala nidra kara.
options: Good night, sleep well.
Good morning, get up early.
Good evening, come inside.

questions.sentence: Amara ghara ku swagata!
options: Dhanyabad, apananka ghara bhari sundara.
Dhanyabad, mu ghara re nahin achi.
Dhanyabad, apana kouthi jauchanti?
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, your home is very beautiful.

questions.sentence: Bhitaraku asantu, apananka swagata.
options: Please come inside, you are welcome.
Please go outside and wait there.
Please sit down and eat something.
questions.correctAnswer: Please come inside, you are welcome.

questions.sentence: Bahut ratri heigala, mu ebe suiba.
options: Thik achi, subha ratri.
Thik achi, subha sakala.
Thik achi, mu ebe asuchi.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, good night.

questions.sentence: Apana sakale kete bele uthanti?
options: Mu bahut sakale uthe.
Mu ratire deri re suae.
Mu sakale kichhi khae nahin.
questions.translatedSentence: I get up very early.

questions.sentence: Aaji sakale bahut thanda achi.
options: It is very cold this morning.
It is very hot this evening.
It is raining a lot today.
questions.correctAnswer: It is very cold this morning.

questions.sentence: Ei nia, apananka pain cha.
options: Bahut dhanyabad, mu ebe piba.
Mu cha kouthi kiniba jane nahin.
Cha pain tike apeksha karantu.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you very much, I will drink it now.

questions.sentence: Sahajya pain bahut dhanyabad.
options: Thank you very much for your help.
Sorry for the trouble I caused you.
Please help me with this bag.
questions.correctAnswer: Thank you very much for your help.

questions.sentence: Kshama karibe, mu deri re asili.
options: Kichhi asubidha nahin, bhitaraku asantu.
Mu bi ebe jauchi, dhanyabad.
Apana kouthi rahanti, tike kuhantu.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem at all, please come in.

questions.sentence: Tike suniba? Jagannath mandira kouthi achi?
options: Sidha jantu, mandira bame padiba.
Mu mandira re kama kare nahin.
Auto re jiba bahut mahanga.
questions.translatedSentence: Go straight, the temple will be on your left.

questions.sentence: Daya kari mote tike sahajya karantu.
options: Please help me for a moment.
Please wait for me outside.
Please do not tell anyone about this.
questions.correctAnswer: Please help me for a moment.

questions.sentence: Mote kshama karantu, mu apananka naam bhuli gali.
options: Kichhi katha nahin, mu puni kahuchi.
Mu apananka katha bujhili nahin.
Mu ebe ghara ku pheruchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kichhi katha nahin, mu puni kahuchi.
questions.translatedSentence: It does not matter, I will say it again.

questions.sentence: Mu dukhita, mora dosa hela.
options: I am sorry, it was my mistake.
I am happy, it was a good day.
I am late, the bus did not come.
questions.correctAnswer: I am sorry, it was my mistake.

questions.sentence: Tike bate deba ki? Mote bahara jibaku achi.
options: Han niscaya, mu tike pakhaku jauchi.
Nahin, mu ebe bahara jiba nahin.
Mu bata jane nahin, kshama karibe.
questions.correctAnswer: Han niscaya, mu tike pakhaku jauchi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes of course, I am moving aside.

questions.sentence: Ete sahajya pain mu apananka nikatare krutagya.
options: I am grateful to you for so much help.
I am waiting for you near the shop.
I am sorry that you had to wait so long.
questions.correctAnswer: I am grateful to you for so much help.

questions.sentence: Achha, mu ebe jauchi.
options: Thik achi, sabadhane jantu.
Thik achi, bhitaraku asantu.
Thik achi, tike apeksha karantu.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, go carefully.

questions.sentence: Ame kali puni bhetiba.
options: We will meet again tomorrow.
We met here yesterday.
We are going there together.

questions.sentence: Aau kebe bheta heba?
options: Agami saptaha re bheta heba.
Kali mu ghara re nathili.
Mu tumaku ebe hin dekhili.
questions.translatedSentence: We will meet next week.

questions.sentence: Mu ebe train dhariba pain jauchi.
options: Sabadhane jantu, pahanchile phone karantu.
Ratire mu bi train re asili.
Mote train stesan ra bata jane nahin.
questions.translatedSentence: Travel safely, call me when you arrive.

questions.sentence: Nijara jatna niantu.
options: Please take care of yourself.
Please take care of the children.
Please look after my bag.

questions.sentence: Mu Bhubaneswar chhadi Cuttack jauchi.
options: Bidaya! Sethi bhala re rahantu.
Bidaya! Mu bi Cuttack ru asichi.
Bidaya! Apana kouthi rahanti?
questions.translatedSentence: Goodbye! Stay well there.

questions.sentence: Bidaya, aau bhetiba.
options: Goodbye, we will meet again.
Hello, it is nice to meet you.
Sorry, I have to leave now.

questions.sentence: Aaji bahut moja hela, dhanyabad.
options: Mo pain bi bhala lagila, puni asantu.
Mu aaji ghara re nathili.
Mote apananka katha bujha padila nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Mo pain bi bhala lagila, puni asantu.
questions.translatedSentence: I enjoyed it too, please come again.

questions.sentence: Mu ebe jauchi, sandhya re pheriba.
options: I am going now, I will come back in the evening.
I am going now, I will not come back today.
I came in the evening and went back.
questions.correctAnswer: I am going now, I will come back in the evening.

questions.sentence: Apana bahut dina ru ethi rahuchanti ki?
options: Han aagya, mu tirisa barsa ru ethi achi.
Nahin aagya, mu ethi kichhi jane nahin.
Han aagya, mu apananka ghara dekhi nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Han aagya, mu tirisa barsa ru ethi achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes sir, I have been living here for thirty years.

questions.sentence: Kaka, apananka baga mu dhariba ki?
options: Uncle, shall I carry your bag for you?
Uncle, is this bag really yours?
Uncle, where did you buy this bag?
questions.correctAnswer: Uncle, shall I carry your bag for you?

questions.sentence: Pua, tume kouthi ru asichha?
options: Aagya, mu Bhubaneswar ru asichi.
Aagya, mu tumaku jane nahin.
Aagya, tume kouthi ru asichha?
questions.translatedSentence: Sir, I have come from Bhubaneswar.

questions.sentence: Bada manankaku sabu bele sammana deba uchit.
options: One should always show respect to elders.
One should always listen to small children.
One should always speak the truth at home.
questions.correctAnswer: One should always show respect to elders.

questions.sentence: Bhitaraku asantu, bahare bahut rodha achi.
options: Dhanyabad, mu bhitaraku asuchi.
Dhanyabad, bahare bahut thanda achi ebe.
Dhanyabad, mu bhitara ra bata jane nahin.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, I am coming inside.

questions.sentence: Apananka nikatare tike samaya achi ki?
options: Han, kuhantu, mu sunuchi.
Nahin, mu samaya jane nahin.
Han, mu ghadi anichi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please tell me, I am listening.

questions.sentence: Daya kari tike aste kuhantu, mu bujhi paruchi nahin.
options: Please speak a little slowly, I cannot understand.
Please speak a little louder, I cannot hear you.
Please say it once more, I have forgotten it.
questions.correctAnswer: Please speak a little slowly, I cannot understand.

questions.sentence: Bus re jaga nahin, apana ethi basantu.
options: Bahut dhanyabad pua, tumara mana bhala.
Bahut dhanyabad, mu bus re jae nahin.
Bahut dhanyabad, mu tikat kini nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Bahut dhanyabad pua, tumara mana bhala.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you very much, son, you have a good heart.

questions.sentence: Apananka saha katha hoi bhala lagila.
options: It was good to talk with you.
It was good to see your house.
It was good that you came early.
questions.correctAnswer: It was good to talk with you.

questions.sentence: Arre, kete dina pare bheta hela, tume kemiti achha?
options: Mu bhala achi, kintu kama bahut badhi gala.
Mu tumaku aji hin prathama thara dekhili.
Mu Puri jibi, jadi tume mote bata kuha.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu bhala achi, kintu kama bahut badhi gala.
questions.translatedSentence: I am fine, but my work has increased a lot.

questions.sentence: Mu tumaku bahut khoji thili, kintu tumara phone bandha thila.
options: I looked for you a lot, but your phone was switched off.
I called you many times, but you never came.
I waited for you outside, because it was raining.
questions.correctAnswer: I looked for you a lot, but your phone was switched off.

questions.sentence: Tume ebe bi Cuttack re rahucha ki?
options: Nahin, mu ebe Bhubaneswar re rahuchi, karana mora kama sethi.
Han, mu Cuttack kebe jai nahin.
Nahin, mu Cuttack ra bata jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, mu ebe Bhubaneswar re rahuchi, karana mora kama sethi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I live in Bhubaneswar now, because my work is there.

questions.sentence: Jadi tume samaya pao, tebe amara ghara ku bhojana pain asa.
options: If you get time, come to our house for a meal.
When you have time, call me on the phone.
Since you have no time, we will meet some other day.
questions.correctAnswer: If you get time, come to our house for a meal.

questions.sentence: Bahut dina hela pakhala khai nahin, tume kana kahucha?
options: Tebe chala, aaji dupura re pakhala aau dalma khaiba.
Tebe chala, mu pakhala ra naam kebe suni nahin.
Tebe chala, pakhala kouthi kiniba mu jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Tebe chala, aaji dupura re pakhala aau dalma khaiba.
questions.translatedSentence: Then come, we will eat pakhala and dalma at noon today.

questions.sentence: Ame sedina Jagannath mandira jaithilu, kintu bhida bahut thila.
options: We went to the Jagannath temple that day, but the crowd was huge.
We are going to the Jagannath temple today, and there is no crowd.
We could not go to the Jagannath temple, because it was raining.
questions.correctAnswer: We went to the Jagannath temple that day, but the crowd was huge.

questions.sentence: Ghara loka sabu kemiti achanti, pila mane bada heigale ki?
options: Han, semane ebe school jauchanti aau bhala padhuchanti.
Han, kintu mu tanka naam ebe bi jane nahin.
Nahin, mu pila mananku aji yaen dekhi nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Han, semane ebe school jauchanti aau bhala padhuchanti.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, they go to school now and they study well.

questions.sentence: Mote ebe jibaku heba, kintu ame puni bheta kariba to?
options: Niscaya, aasanta saptaha re mu tumaku phone kariba.
Niscaya, kintu mu auto re jiba nahin.
Niscaya, mu ebe hin ghara pahanchi gali.
questions.correctAnswer: Niscaya, aasanta saptaha re mu tumaku phone kariba.
questions.translatedSentence: Of course, I will call you next week.

questions.sentence: Bahut dina pare bheta hela, tumaku dekhi mote bhari khusi lagila.
options: We met after a long time, and I was very happy to see you.
We meet every day, so seeing you is nothing special.
It has been a long time, but I still could not see you.
questions.correctAnswer: We met after a long time, and I was very happy to see you.
